//@version=6
indicator("QB timeframe calendar diagnostics", overlay=false)
plot(bar_index, "bar_index")
plot(time, "time")
plot(time("D"), "time_D")
plot(time("W"), "time_W")
plot(time("M"), "time_M")
plot(timeframe.change("D") ? 1 : 0, "change_D")
plot(timeframe.change("W") ? 1 : 0, "change_W")
plot(timeframe.change("M") ? 1 : 0, "change_M")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds(), "chart_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("M"), "month_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("3M"), "three_month_seconds")
plot(year, "year")
plot(month, "month")
plot(dayofweek, "dayofweek")
plot(hour, "hour")
plot(minute, "minute")
plot(hour(timestamp("UTC",2026,3,8,6,59),"America/New_York"), "spring_before_hour")
plot(hour(timestamp("UTC",2026,3,8,7,0),"America/New_York"), "spring_after_hour")
plot(hour(timestamp("UTC",2026,11,1,5,59),"America/New_York"), "fall_before_hour")
plot(hour(timestamp("UTC",2026,11,1,6,0),"America/New_York"), "fall_after_hour")
plot(minute(timestamp("UTC",2026,11,1,5,59),"America/New_York"), "fall_before_minute")
plot(minute(timestamp("UTC",2026,11,1,6,0),"America/New_York"), "fall_after_minute")
plot(timeframe.multiplier, "timeframe_multiplier")
plot(timeframe.isintraday ? 1 : 0, "timeframe_isintraday")
var first_day_change = timeframe.change("D")
var first_week_change = timeframe.change("W")
var first_month_change = timeframe.change("M")
var first_timestamp = time
plot(first_day_change ? 1 : 0, "first_day_change")
plot(first_week_change ? 1 : 0, "first_week_change")
plot(first_month_change ? 1 : 0, "first_month_change")
plot(first_timestamp, "first_timestamp")

//@version=5
indicator("QB v5 timeframe first state", overlay=false)
var first_day_change = timeframe.change("D")
var first_week_change = timeframe.change("W")
var first_month_change = timeframe.change("M")
var first_timestamp = time
plot(na(first_day_change) ? -1 : first_day_change ? 1 : 0, "first_day_change")
plot(na(first_week_change) ? -1 : first_week_change ? 1 : 0, "first_week_change")
plot(na(first_month_change) ? -1 : first_month_change ? 1 : 0, "first_month_change")
plot(first_timestamp, "first_timestamp")
plot(bar_index, "bar_index")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("1M"), "month_1_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("2M"), "month_2_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("3M"), "month_3_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("4M"), "month_4_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("5M"), "month_5_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("6M"), "month_6_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("7M"), "month_7_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("8M"), "month_8_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("9M"), "month_9_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("10M"), "month_10_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("11M"), "month_11_seconds")
plot(timeframe.in_seconds("12M"), "month_12_seconds")
f_history(x) =>
    total = 0.0
    for j = 0 to 2
        total += nz(x[j],0)
    total
history_source = bar_index + 1.0
history_actual = f_history(history_source)
history_actual_ten = f_history(history_source * 10)
history_expected = history_source + nz(history_source[1],0) + nz(history_source[2],0)
plot(history_actual, "own_loop_actual")
plot(history_expected, "own_loop_expected")
plot(history_actual_ten, "own_loop_actual_ten")
plot(history_expected * 10, "own_loop_expected_ten")
